source: Only historical parent seat-0 action tapes of terrains previously assigned to TRAIN by cargo_tree_action_learning_dev/panel.json with 621470000 <= seed < 621500000. Both actual public perspectives per tape, the final three hash-ranked terrains held out of this estimator. No first-win, fresh/formal, 345..355 or published ladder terrains used. Prior actor weights saw these historical training terrains; held-out refers to this estimator only.
split_order: ascending sha256('public-hidden-carbon-v1/' + physical terrain hash); last 3 held
predictor: Identical historical Sapling/75% owned it50 policy; an independent local residual MLP edits only Sapling encoder map channel 0. Eligible iff never directly observed by this seat including current step, and not a public current base or tree. Other public maps, both prefixes and it50 frozen. No action overrides, examiner features, teacher weights, counters, oracle or future information at inference. Both packages and partner share identical baseline history.
inputs: Use live incumbent canonical map channels/history: local estimate, last direct reading, observation flags, ages, mirror-derived estimates, worker occupancy, tree/base state and tree adjacency; toroidal four-neighbor means and reflection-orbit summaries of the actual public map channels. Additional public input is incumbent Feat.inf, the already tracked first stationary collector cargo-gain estimate and timestamp per physical cell from either visible roster. Aggregate over the cell and row/column/both reflected copies. These are observations about historical cells, not hard mirror substitutions. Include elapsed step. No seed, terrain hash, player identity or opponent parameters.
train: One 32-unit ReLU hidden layer followed by scalar residual on baseline fraction. Unit-level feature vectors share weights across sites. All eligible cells in both perspectives of every sixth turn (0..298), smooth L1 delta 0.03 in [0,1] units before clipping. One seeded run (19113), Adam 0.002, 18 epochs minibatches of 1024 eligible cells shuffled deterministically; fixed final weights. Bias-only comparator fitted to identical cells/loss/epochs/optimizer with no other parameters, identical correction placement, q8 clip(round*255), and eligibility. Save floats as f32. No sweep or selection.
ground_truth: Referee ground truth from replaying archived physical joint actions against FastCarbon; match initial terrain digest, assert every sampled visible cell against public carbon and terminal cash vs original last_post_cash. Never provide full_carbon to agent. Labels are solely simulator carbon *at the time of the current observation*.
metrics: On 3 held terrain, same predeclared turns/perspectives. Report macro terrain and micro MAE all hidden and eligible; local legal/economic pair accuracy incl 0.5 credit for predicted ties with unequal true targets, tie rate and expected true regret under uniform argmax tie breaks among hidden actionable collector destination carbon / planter destination four-neighbor mean. Eligible worker target requires legal move after archived joint prefix, a productive non-tree/base collection site, or plantable off-base unowned soil with cash sufficient; use hidden collector cell or planter mean with at least one hidden neighbor. Count/map all comparisons and regrets, preserve breakdowns by terrain and role. Compare three packages; report signed per-terrain results, no win-rate inference.
normal_entry: First validation card in array order. Run incumbent, constant and student normal public entry from step 0 to final archived transition for each perspective, on same fixed official action tape. Compare packed inputs partner bitwise and other channels/aux untouched, document physical action changes, package bytes, local single-thread wall distributions and full-entry correctness. Timing here is local smoke; hosted ladder latency is separate.
selection: Fixed final learner. Representation progress requires lower hidden micro MAE and lower macro eligible MAE than BOTH incumbent and constant, with visible cells bit-identical. Decision-relevant evidence requires actual normal-entry action change and report both roles (regressions included). No win claim from same-state replay.
